WNBC’s Jessica Cunnington reports for Sunday TODAY.

Ministry of Culture posts video of Roman finds near Trapani, Italy.
About three miles off the coast of Mazara del Vallo, at a depth of 46 meters, a Roman shipwreck has been discovered, believed to date from between the 2nd and 1st centuries B.C., containing hundreds of amphorae, two large lead anchor stocks, and other artifacts.
